title: Father me
lyrics: Father, father me, I need your love, I need your love
I feel so alone, longing for a home
I need comfort, I need shelter
I need healing for my soul
Take this fear that I surrender
Take me in, take me home, father me
Father, father me, call me by name, call me by name
Father, oh please pardon me, take me to your home
I need comfort, I need shelter
I need healing for my soul
Take this pain that I surrender
Take me in, take me home
Father, father me, I need your love, I need your love
Father, father me, take me to your home
Adopt me as your own, father me
